arxiv-2105-14362.title: Dash Sylvereye: A WebGL-powered Library for Dashboard-driven Visualization of Large Street Networks
arxiv-2105-14362.creator: ALBERTO GARCIA-ROBLEDO 1, MAHBOOBEH ZANGIABADY 2
arxiv-2105-14362.description: Abstract State-of-the-art open network visualization tools like Gephi, KeyLines, and Cytoscape are not suitable for studying street networks with thousands of roads since they do not support simultaneously polylines for edges, navigable maps, GPU-accelerated rendering, interactivity, and the means for visualizing multivariate data.

arxiv-2405-20247.title: KerasCV and KerasNLP: Vision and Language Power-Ups
arxiv-2405-20247.creator: Lead Authors, { mattdangerw, divyasreepat, fchollet, mgorner, ksodhia}@google.com, Keras Team, Google LLC, USA, Community Contributors, { sharmabhee, shivanshuman021}@gmail.com
arxiv-2405-20247.description: Abstract We present the Keras domain packages KerasCV and KerasNLP, extensions of the Keras API for Computer Vision and Natural Language Processing workflows, capable of running on either JAX, TensorFlow, or PyTorch. These domain packages are designed to enable fast experimentation, with a focus on ease-of-use and performance.

arxiv-2406-02411.title: Decoupling of neural network calibration measures
arxiv-2406-02411.creator: Dominik Werner Wolf, Prasannavenkatesh Balaji, Alexander Braun, Markus Ulrich
arxiv-2406-02411.description: Abstract A lot of effort is currently invested in safeguarding autonomous driving systems, which heavily rely on deep neural networks for computer vision. We investigate the coupling of different neural network calibration measures with a special focus on the Area Under the Sparsification Error curve (AUSE) metric.

arxiv-2502-15872.title: MutaGReP : Execution-Free Repository-Grounded Plan Search for Code-Use
arxiv-2502-15872.creator: Zaid Khan, Ali Farhadi, Ranjay Krishna, Luca Weihs, Mohit Bansal, Tanmay Gupta
arxiv-2502-15872.description: Abstract When a human requests an LLM to complete a coding task using functionality from a large code repository, how do we provide context from the repo to the LLM? One approach is to add the entire repo to the LLM’s context window.

arxiv-2502-20450.title: Universal electronic structure of multi-layered nickelates via oxygen-centered planar orbitals
arxiv-2502-20450.creator: Christine C. Au-Yeung, X. Chen, S. Smit, M. Bluschke, V. Zimmermann, M. Michiardi, P. C. Moen, J. Kraan, C. S. B. Pang, C. T. Suen, S. Zhdanovich, M. Zonno, S. Gorovikov, Y. Liu, G. Levy, I. S. Elfimov, M. Berciu, G. A. Sawatzky, J. F. Mitchell, A. Damascelli
arxiv-2502-20450.description: Abstract In a series of groundbreaking discoveries, superconductivity has been demonstrated in the family of multi-layered nickelates La 3 Ni 2 O 7 and La 4 Ni 3 O 10 , with T c T_{c} as high as 91 and 30K respectively under moderate pressure. Key questions remain open regarding the low-energy electronic states that support superconductivity in these compounds.

arxiv-2506-10628.title: Leveraging Low-rank Factorizations of Conditional Correlation Matrices in Graph Learning
arxiv-2506-10628.creator: Thu Ha Phi, Alexandre Hippert-Ferrer, Florent Bouchard, Arnaud Breloy
arxiv-2506-10628.description: Abstract This paper addresses the problem of learning an undirected graph from data gathered at each nodes. Within the graph signal processing framework, the topology of such graph can be linked to the support of the conditional correlation matrix of the data.

arxiv-2510-13127.title: Precision Design of Cyclic Peptides using AlphaFold
arxiv-2510-13127.creator: AU, Cheuk Sau (Jethro)
arxiv-2510-13127.description: Abstract This independent research investigates methods to improve the precision of cyclic peptide generation targeting the HIV gp120 trimer using AlphaFold. The study explores proximity-based hotspot mapping at the CD4 binding site, centroid distance penalization, generative loss tuning, and custom loss function development. These enhancements produced cyclic peptides that closely resemble the binding conformation of the CD4 attachment inhibitor BMS-818251.

arxiv-2602-21568.title: From Ad-Hoc Scripts to Orchestrated Pipelines: Architecting a Resilient ELT Framework for Developer Productivity Metrics
arxiv-2602-21568.creator: Yuvraj Agrawal, Pallav Jain
arxiv-2602-21568.description: Abstract Developer Productivity Dashboards are essential for visualizing DevOps performance metrics such as Deployment Frequency and Change Failure Rate (DORA). However, the utility of these dashboards is frequently undermined by data reliability issues. In early iterations of our platform, ad-hoc ingestion scripts (Cron jobs) led to ”silent failures,” where data gaps went undetected for days, eroding organizational trust.

pmc-10529655.creator: Nadja Kadom, Kartik Reddy, Maxwell E Cooper, Jack Knight-Scott, Richard A Jones, Susan Palasis, Kim M Cecil, Stefan Bluml
pmc-10529655.description: Contextual design and selection of MRI protocols is critical for making an accurate diagnosis given the wide variety of clinical indications for spine imaging in children. Here, we describe our pediatric spine imaging protocols in detail, tailored to specific clinical questions.Keywords: radiology, pediatric, imaging, spine, mri protocol, protocoling, contextual 1.

pmc-11470178.title: Induction of LARP1B under endoplasmic reticulum stress and its regulatory role in proliferation of esophageal squamous cell carcinoma
pmc-11470178.creator: Xia Yang, Juntao Lu, Fangyu Su, Junhong Wu, Xinhao Wang, Zhaokun Hu, Zhaoyang Yan, Huanchen Xu, Xiaobin Shang, Wei Guo
pmc-11470178.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Highlights•LARP1B is up-regulated in ESCC cells upon endoplasmic reticulum stress.•XBP1 stimulates the transcription of LARP1B in response to ER stress.•LARP1B is highly expressed in ESCC tissues and cells.•LARP1B promotes the proliferation of ESCC cells by maintaining CCND1 mRNA levels.Keywords: LARP1B, Endoplasmic reticulum stress, Proliferation Introduction Esophageal cancer ranks among the prevalent malignant tumors of the digestive system, posing a significant risk to human health due to its severe morbidity and mortality.

pmc-11635658.title: Pazopanib in the real-world setting in soft tissue sarcomas: data from the Italian national registry
pmc-11635658.creator: B. Vincenzi, P.P. Olimpieri, S. Celant, A. Mazzocca, A. Cortellini, A. Comandone, L. Tomassini, S. Di Segni, P. Russo, P.G. Casali
pmc-11635658.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). BackgroundPazopanib is part of the therapeutic armamentarium for the treatment of patients with advanced non-adipocytic soft tissue sarcomas (STS) who have received prior chemotherapy, but its optimal use in STS histologies is still left to be further defined.Design and methodsData on STS patients treated with pazopanib in Italy have been prospectively collected from July 2013 to December 2019 through a drug monitoring registry managed by the Italian Medicines Agency (AIFA).

pmc-12387387.title: CFTR Modulators Counteract F508del CFTR Functional Defects in a Pancreatic Epithelial Model of Cystic Fibrosis
pmc-12387387.creator: Alessandra Ludovico, Debora Baroni, Janice Wang, Patricia A Walker
pmc-12387387.description: Cystic fibrosis is a multisystem disorder caused by mutations in the CFTR gene that lead to impaired ion and fluid transport across secretory epithelia. Although the therapeutic impact of CFTR modulators has been extensively studied in airway epithelia, their efficacy in extra-pulmonary tissues, such as the pancreas, has been less explored.

pmc-12713557.title: Evaluation of awareness, attitudes, and practices towards disaster preparedness among Saudi healthcare professionals: implications for enhancing emergency response and training
pmc-12713557.creator: Ashokkumar Thirunavukkarasu, Aseel Awad Alsaidan, Sayer T. Aldhafeeri, Doaa Mazen Abdel-Salam, Nasser T. Aldhafeeri, Muzun Ali Alanazi, Randa Mansour Almughamisi, Diyam Khalid Alkawkbei, Wijdan Al-Zahrany
pmc-12713557.description: Background and AimDisaster management and preparedness by healthcare professionals (HCPs) are integral to safeguarding public health. The present study assessed the awareness, attitude, and practice of disaster preparedness among HCPs of the central Saudi Arabia region. Furthermore, the present study determined the predictors associated with these three domains.

pmc-13493034.title: Maternal and Foetal Risk Factors for Stillbirth: A Retrospective Case-Control Study at Al-Buraimi Hospital, Oman
pmc-13493034.creator: Rubana Gulshan, Samina Begum, Mili Biswas, Asma Ghani, Rabia Zulfiqar, Maryam Javed
pmc-13493034.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundStillbirth is a significant public health issue. The maternal and foetal risk factors often contribute to adverse outcomes. In Oman, while substantial improvements have been made in maternal and neonatal care, stillbirth remains a preventable tragedy in many cases.
